verses.rationale: Preserves census-origin silver and exact 100/1775, introducing per-person explanation.
verses.before: The silver from those counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel:
verses.after: The silver from those counted in the community came to a hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels by the sanctuary standard:
verses.tsw_comparator: The silver from those counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the sanctuary shekel:

verses.rationale: Retains named beka and half-shekel equivalence, age threshold and exact 603550 census count without shrinking ancient numerical claim.
verses.before: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel according to the sanctuary shekel, for everyone who passed over to those counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.
verses.after: a beka per person, half a shekel by the sanctuary standard, from everyone counted who was twenty years old or older—six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty in all.
verses.tsw_comparator: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel according to the sanctuary shekel, for everyone who passed over to those counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

verses.rationale: Preserves three hundred references and one-per-base arithmetic covering sanctuary and curtain supports.
verses.before: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil: one hundred bases from one hundred talents, a talent for a base.
verses.after: The hundred talents of silver were used to cast the sanctuary’s bases and the curtain’s bases: a hundred bases from a hundred talents, one talent per base.
verses.tsw_comparator: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the bases of the sanctuary and the bases of the veil: one hundred bases from one hundred talents, a talent for a base.

verses.rationale: Retains remaining silver total and all three uses with supplied shekel unit from prior account.
verses.before: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their tops, and made bands for them.
verses.after: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their tops, and fitted them with bands.
verses.tsw_comparator: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their tops, and made bands for them.

verses.rationale: Keeps 70/2400 bronze total and offering provenance.
verses.before: The bronze from the wave offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
verses.after: The bronze presented as an offering came to seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.
verses.tsw_comparator: The bronze from the wave offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

verses.rationale: Preserves first group of bronze uses and continuing list rather than replacing with generic equipment.
verses.before: With it he made the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze network, all the utensils of the altar,
verses.after: With it he made the bases for the entrance to the tent of meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze grating, and all the altar’s utensils,
verses.tsw_comparator: With it he made the bases for the entrance of the tent of meeting, the bronze altar and its bronze network, all the utensils of the altar,

verses.rationale: Preserves courtyard bases both perimeter/entrance and both sets of pegs as bronze-account conclusion.
verses.before: the bases around the court, the bases of the gate of the court, all the pegs of the dwelling, and all the pegs around the court.
verses.after: the bases around the courtyard and at its entrance, and all the tent pegs for the tabernacle and the surrounding courtyard.
verses.tsw_comparator: the bases around the court, the bases of the gate of the court, all the pegs of the dwelling, and all the pegs around the court.

verses.rationale: Keeps service-garment uncertainty and Aaron’s garments distinct, preserving first fulfillment refrain.
verses.before: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place. They made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: From blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made the garments for service in the sanctuary. They made Aaron’s holy garments, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: From the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn they made woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place. They made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Preserves singular maker shift and all ephod materials without forcing new named agent.
verses.before: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen.
verses.after: He made the ephod from gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen.
verses.tsw_comparator: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen.

verses.rationale: Retains plural hammering/singular cutting and explicit gold-thread manufacture rather than implying whole gold cloth.
verses.before: They hammered the gold into thin sheets and cut it into threads to work into the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and the fine linen, the work of a skilled designer.
verses.after: They hammered the gold into thin sheets, and he cut it into threads to work into the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine linen as part of the skilled design.
verses.tsw_comparator: They hammered the gold into thin sheets and cut it into threads to work into the blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and the fine linen, the work of a skilled designer.

verses.rationale: Preserves shoulder connections, two ends and full written/read source annotation.
verses.before: They made shoulder pieces for it, joined together; at its two edges it was joined.
verses.after: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, joining it together at its two ends.
verses.tsw_comparator: They made shoulder pieces for it, joined together; at its two edges it was joined.

verses.rationale: Keeps integrated waistband/material repetition and fulfillment refrain.
verses.before: The skillfully woven band upon it, with which it was fastened, was of one piece with it and of the same workmanship: gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: Its woven waistband was of one piece with it and made the same way: gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: The skillfully woven band upon it, with which it was fastened, was of one piece with it and of the same workmanship: gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Retains provisional onyx, gold settings, seal technique and ancestral names.
verses.before: They prepared the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved like the engravings of a signet with the names of the children of Israel.
verses.after: They prepared the onyx stones in gold settings, engraved like seals with the names of Israel’s sons.
verses.tsw_comparator: They prepared the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved like the engravings of a signet with the names of the children of Israel.

verses.rationale: Keeps singular installation, shoulders, memorial function and repeated command fulfillment.
verses.before: He put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of remembrance for the children of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: He put them on the ephod’s shoulder pieces as memorial stones for Israel’s sons, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: He put them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as stones of remembrance for the children of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Retains full material/design correspondence without adding judgment term absent in this verse.
verses.before: He made the breastpiece, the work of a skilled designer, like the workmanship of the ephod: of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen.
verses.after: He made the breastpiece with a skilled design, like the ephod, from gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and finely twisted linen.
verses.tsw_comparator: He made the breastpiece, the work of a skilled designer, like the workmanship of the ephod: of gold, blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen.

verses.rationale: Preserves plural makers, repeated doubled condition and span-by-span dimensions.
verses.before: It was square and folded double; they made the breastpiece a span long and a span wide when folded double.
verses.after: They made the breastpiece square and folded double, a span long and a span wide when doubled.
verses.tsw_comparator: It was square and folded double; they made the breastpiece a span long and a span wide when folded double.

verses.rationale: Preserves four rows and provisional stone names matching 28:17.
verses.before: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of carnelian, topaz, and emerald was the first row;
verses.after: They set four rows of stones in it. The first row was carnelian, topaz, and emerald;
verses.tsw_comparator: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of carnelian, topaz, and emerald was the first row;

verses.rationale: Preserves row order and same provisional terms as 28:18.
verses.before: the second row: turquoise, sapphire, and diamond;
verses.after: the second row, turquoise, sapphire, and moonstone;
verses.tsw_comparator: the second row: turquoise, sapphire, and diamond;

verses.rationale: Preserves row order and same provisional terms as 28:19.
verses.before: the third row: jacinth, agate, and amethyst;
verses.after: the third row, jacinth, agate, and amethyst;
verses.tsw_comparator: the third row: jacinth, agate, and amethyst;

verses.rationale: Keeps final row sequence and all gold settings, same provisional terms as 28:20.
verses.before: the fourth row: beryl, onyx, and jasper. They were enclosed in settings of gold.
verses.after: and the fourth row, beryl, onyx, and jasper. The stones were mounted in gold settings.
verses.tsw_comparator: the fourth row: beryl, onyx, and jasper. They were enclosed in settings of gold.

verses.rationale: Retains twelve twice, one name per stone and tribal representation.
verses.before: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve according to their names, engraved like a signet, each according to its name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.after: The twelve stones bore the names of Israel’s sons. Each was engraved like a seal with one name, for the twelve tribes.
verses.tsw_comparator: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve according to their names, engraved like a signet, each according to its name, for the twelve tribes.

verses.rationale: Preserves pure gold chains and corded workmanship.
verses.before: They made on the breastpiece chains like cords, of twisted pure gold.
verses.after: They made chains of pure gold for the breastpiece, twisted like cords.
verses.tsw_comparator: They made on the breastpiece chains like cords, of twisted pure gold.

verses.rationale: Keeps four distinct two-count references and component relationships.
verses.before: They made two settings of gold and two rings of gold and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.
verses.after: They made two gold settings and two gold rings, and attached the two rings to the two ends of the breastpiece.
verses.tsw_comparator: They made two settings of gold and two rings of gold and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastpiece.

verses.rationale: Preserves two cords to two rings at breastpiece ends.
verses.before: They put the two twisted cords of gold into the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.
verses.after: They attached the two gold cords to the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.
verses.tsw_comparator: They put the two twisted cords of gold into the two rings at the ends of the breastpiece.

verses.rationale: Keeps distal chain ends, settings and front shoulder relation.
verses.before: They put the two ends of the two cords on the two settings and attached them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at its front.
verses.after: They attached the other ends of the two cords to the two settings, fastening them to the shoulder pieces on the front of the ephod.
verses.tsw_comparator: They put the two ends of the two cords on the two settings and attached them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at its front.

verses.rationale: Preserves additional pair and inner-facing location without conflating earlier outer pair.
verses.before: They made two rings of gold and put them on the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge next to the ephod.
verses.after: They made two more gold rings and put them at the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge facing the ephod.
verses.tsw_comparator: They made two rings of gold and put them on the two ends of the breastpiece, on its inner edge next to the ephod.

verses.rationale: Retains low/front/seam/above spatial constraints in natural sequence.
verses.before: They made two more rings of gold and put them on the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, low on its front, near its joining, above the woven band of the ephod.
verses.after: They made two gold rings and attached them low on the front of the ephod’s two shoulder pieces, near the seam and above its waistband.
verses.tsw_comparator: They made two more rings of gold and put them on the two shoulder pieces of the ephod, low on its front, near its joining, above the woven band of the ephod.

verses.rationale: Keeps fastening, cord color, position and no-loosening purpose with fulfillment refrain.
verses.before: They bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that it rested on the woven band of the ephod and did not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: They tied the breastpiece’s rings to the ephod’s rings with a blue cord, so it sat above the waistband and did not come loose from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: They bound the breastpiece by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that it rested on the woven band of the ephod and did not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Retains woven technique and wholly blue garment distinct from multicolor ephod.
verses.before: He made the robe of the ephod, the work of a weaver, entirely of blue.
verses.after: He wove the robe worn with the ephod entirely from blue yarn.
verses.tsw_comparator: He made the robe of the ephod, the work of a weaver, entirely of blue.

verses.rationale: Keeps rare armor-opening comparison with uncertainty note and reinforced-edge function.
verses.before: The opening of the robe was in its middle, like the opening of a coat of armor, with a binding around its opening so that it would not tear.
verses.after: The robe had an opening in the middle like that of a coat of armor, with an edge around the opening so it would not tear.
verses.tsw_comparator: The opening of the robe was in its middle, like the opening of a coat of armor, with a binding around its opening so that it would not tear.

verses.rationale: Preserves plural makers, three colors, twisted yarn and hem placement.
verses.before: On the hem of the robe they made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen.
verses.after: They made pomegranates around the robe’s hem from twisted blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.
verses.tsw_comparator: On the hem of the robe they made pomegranates of blue, purple, and scarlet yarn and fine twisted linen.

verses.rationale: Retains deliberate repeated between placement instead of collapsing literary repetition.
verses.before: They made bells of pure gold and put the bells between the pomegranates around the hem of the robe, between the pomegranates:
verses.after: They made bells of pure gold and placed them between the pomegranates all around the robe’s hem, between the pomegranates.
verses.tsw_comparator: They made bells of pure gold and put the bells between the pomegranates around the hem of the robe, between the pomegranates:

verses.rationale: Preserves alternating repeated pattern, service purpose and refrain without forcing independent full sentence.
verses.before: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe for ministering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: A bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, all around the robe’s hem for service, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the hem of the robe for ministering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Retains woven material and named father/sons recipients while beginning continued garment list.
verses.before: They made the tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons,
verses.after: They wove fine linen tunics for Aaron and his sons,
verses.tsw_comparator: They made the tunics of fine linen, the work of a weaver, for Aaron and for his sons,

verses.rationale: Keeps distinct turban/head coverings/undergarments and ornamental quality alongside repeated linen.
verses.before: and the turban of fine linen, the splendid head coverings of fine linen, the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen,
verses.after: the fine linen turban and ornate head coverings of fine linen, and linen undergarments of finely twisted linen,
verses.tsw_comparator: and the turban of fine linen, the splendid head coverings of fine linen, the linen undergarments of fine twisted linen,

verses.rationale: Preserves sash materials and embroidery technique with fulfillment refrain.
verses.before: and the sash of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, the work of an embroiderer, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: and the sash, embroidered in finely twisted linen and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: and the sash of fine twisted linen and blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, the work of an embroiderer, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Keeps plate/diadem relation, purity, seal engraving and exact inscription consistent with 28:36.
verses.before: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold and wrote on it an inscription like the engraving of a signet: “Holy to the LORD.”
verses.after: They made the plate of the holy diadem from pure gold and engraved on it, like a seal, “Holy to the LORD.”
verses.tsw_comparator: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold and wrote on it an inscription like the engraving of a signet: “Holy to the LORD.”

verses.rationale: Retains blue cord, upper-turban placement and refrain without importing front location absent here.
verses.before: They put a cord of blue yarn on it to fasten it upon the turban above, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: They fastened a blue cord to it to attach it high on the turban, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: They put a cord of blue yarn on it to fasten it upon the turban above, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Preserves completion, double sanctuary designation and emphatic repeated obedience claim.
verses.before: Thus all the work of the dwelling, the tent of meeting, was completed. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses; so they did.
verses.after: So all the work on the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, was finished. The Israelites had done everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses; that is what they did.
verses.tsw_comparator: Thus all the work of the dwelling, the tent of meeting, was completed. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses; so they did.

verses.rationale: Keeps full structural inventory and exact written/read crossbar annotation with list continuing across labels.
verses.before: They brought the dwelling to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, pillars, and bases;
verses.after: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent and all its equipment—clasps, frames, crossbars, pillars, and bases;
verses.tsw_comparator: They brought the dwelling to Moses: the tent and all its furnishings, its clasps, frames, crossbars, pillars, and bases;

verses.rationale: Preserves two covering layers and inner screen, with uncertain skin identity.
verses.before: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the screening veil;
verses.after: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of taḥash skins, and the screening curtain;
verses.tsw_comparator: the covering of ram skins dyed red, the covering of fine leather, and the screening veil;

verses.rationale: Keeps testimony and atonement terms in inventory of three associated components.
verses.before: the ark of the testimony with its poles and the cover;
verses.after: the ark of the testimony with its poles and the atonement cover;
verses.tsw_comparator: the ark of the testimony with its poles and the cover;

verses.rationale: Retains bread distinct from equipment and familiar Presence term.
verses.before: the table, all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;
verses.after: the table with all its utensils and the bread of the Presence;
verses.tsw_comparator: the table, all its utensils, and the bread of the Presence;

verses.rationale: Retains purity, arrangement qualifier, utensils and lighting oil.
verses.before: the pure lampstand, its lamps, the lamps set in order, all its utensils, and the oil for the light;
verses.after: the pure lampstand, its lamps arranged in order, all its utensils, and the oil for the light;
verses.tsw_comparator: the pure lampstand, its lamps, the lamps set in order, all its utensils, and the oil for the light;

verses.rationale: Keeps gold altar designation and associated aromatics and screen without adding incense to altar’s name here.
verses.before: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance of the tent;
verses.after: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the screen for the tent’s entrance;
verses.tsw_comparator: the gold altar, the anointing oil, the fragrant incense, and the screen for the entrance of the tent;

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated bronze and full altar/basin inventory.
verses.before: the bronze altar and its bronze grate, its poles and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;
verses.after: the bronze altar with its bronze grating, its poles and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand;
verses.tsw_comparator: the bronze altar and its bronze grate, its poles and all its utensils, the basin and its stand;

verses.rationale: Retains all courtyard components and all-service summary, not reducing repeated sanctuary titles.
verses.before: the hangings of the court, its pillars and bases, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords and pegs, and all the utensils for the service of the dwelling, for the tent of meeting;
verses.after: the courtyard hangings with their pillars and bases, the screen for its entrance, its ropes and pegs, and all the equipment for the service of the tabernacle, the tent of meeting;
verses.tsw_comparator: the hangings of the court, its pillars and bases, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords and pegs, and all the utensils for the service of the dwelling, for the tent of meeting;

verses.rationale: Keeps three garment descriptions and named recipients, matching earlier inventory without resolving rare textile term.
verses.before: the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons for priestly service.
verses.after: and the garments for service in the sanctuary, Aaron the priest’s holy garments, and his sons’ garments for serving as priests.
verses.tsw_comparator: the woven garments for ministering in the Holy Place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons for priestly service.

verses.rationale: Retains collective agency and full-work fulfillment refrain even after similar summary in verse 32.
verses.before: According to all that the LORD had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
verses.after: The Israelites did all the work just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: According to all that the LORD had commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

verses.rationale: Keeps inspection, repeated confirmation and Moses’ blessing rather than invented approval ceremony.
verses.before: Moses saw all the work, and look, they had done it; as the LORD had commanded, so they had done. And Moses blessed them.
verses.after: Moses inspected all the work and saw that they had done it just as the LORD had commanded. That is what they had done. Then Moses blessed them.
verses.tsw_comparator: Moses saw all the work, and look, they had done it; as the LORD had commanded, so they had done. And Moses blessed them.

verses.rationale: Preserves source speech formula introducing installation command.
verses.before: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.after: The LORD spoke to Moses:
verses.tsw_comparator: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

verses.rationale: Retains exact day/month and double sanctuary designation without adding year until verse 17.
verses.before: “On the first day of the first month you will set up the dwelling, the tent of meeting.
verses.after: “On the first day of the first month, set up the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.
verses.tsw_comparator: “On the first day of the first month you shall set up the dwelling, the tent of meeting.

verses.rationale: Keeps ark inside, testimony and screening action distinct from covering ark with a cloth.
verses.before: You will put there the ark of the testimony and screen the ark with the veil.
verses.after: Place the ark of the testimony inside and screen it with the dividing curtain.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put there the ark of the testimony and screen the ark with the veil.

verses.rationale: Retains nonspecific table arrangement here rather than importing bread before verse 23, plus lamp installation/lighting.
verses.before: You will bring in the table and arrange what belongs on it. You will bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.
verses.after: Bring in the table and arrange what belongs on it. Bring in the lampstand and light its lamps.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall bring in the table and arrange what belongs on it. You shall bring in the lampstand and set up its lamps.

verses.rationale: Preserves relation to ark with curtain context and distinct entrance screen.
verses.before: You will put the gold altar for incense before the ark of the testimony and set up the screen at the entrance of the dwelling.
verses.after: Put the gold incense altar in front of the ark of the testimony, and hang the entrance screen for the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put the gold altar for incense before the ark of the testimony and set up the screen at the entrance of the dwelling.

verses.rationale: Keeps outer altar position and repeated sanctuary designation.
verses.before: You will put the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the dwelling, the tent of meeting.
verses.after: Place the altar of burnt offering in front of the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put the altar of burnt offering before the entrance of the dwelling, the tent of meeting.

verses.rationale: Retains between relation and water provision.
verses.before: You will put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.
verses.after: Put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and fill it with water.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it.

verses.rationale: Keeps surrounding court and gate screen installation.
verses.before: You will set up the court all around and hang the screen at the gate of the court.
verses.after: Set up the courtyard all around and hang the screen at its entrance.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall set up the court all around and hang the screen at the gate of the court.

verses.rationale: Preserves anointing/consecration actions and exhaustive object scope.
verses.before: “You will take the anointing oil and anoint the dwelling and all that is in it. You will consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it will be holy.
verses.after: Take the anointing oil and anoint the tabernacle and everything in it. Consecrate it and all its utensils, so it becomes holy.
verses.tsw_comparator: “You shall take the anointing oil and anoint the dwelling and all that is in it. You shall consecrate it and all its furnishings, and it shall be holy.

verses.rationale: Keeps separate altar ritual and intensified holy of holies designation.
verses.before: You will anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils and consecrate the altar, and the altar will be most holy.
verses.after: Anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils. Consecrate the altar, so it becomes most holy.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils and consecrate the altar, and the altar shall be most holy.

verses.rationale: Retains basin/stand distinction and consecration command.
verses.before: You will anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate it.
verses.after: Anoint the basin and its stand, and consecrate it.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall anoint the basin and its stand and consecrate it.

verses.rationale: Keeps named priests, entrance location and Moses as washing agent.
verses.before: Then you will bring Aaron and his sons near to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.after: Bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then you shall bring Aaron and his sons near to the entrance of the tent of meeting and wash them with water.

verses.rationale: Preserves Aaron’s clothing/anointing/consecration sequence and service purpose.
verses.before: You will clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him, and consecrate him so that he may serve as priest to me.
verses.after: Dress Aaron in the holy garments, anoint him, and consecrate him to serve me as priest.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall clothe Aaron with the holy garments, anoint him, and consecrate him so that he may serve as priest to me.

verses.rationale: Keeps sons’ separate clothing step and tunic specificity.
verses.before: You will bring his sons near and clothe them with tunics.
verses.after: Bring his sons forward and dress them in tunics.
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall bring his sons near and clothe them with tunics.

verses.rationale: Retains father comparison and enduring hereditary service without upgrading to independent approval of descendants.
verses.before: You will anoint them as you anointed their father, so that they may serve as priests to me. Their anointing will be for them a perpetual priesthood throughout their generations.”
verses.after: Anoint them as you anointed their father, so they may serve me as priests. Their anointing will establish a lasting priesthood for them throughout their generations.”
verses.tsw_comparator: You shall anoint them as you anointed their father, so that they may serve as priests to me. Their anointing shall be for them a perpetual priesthood throughout their generations.”

verses.rationale: Preserves emphatic repeated obedience summary before detailed execution.
verses.before: Moses did according to all that the LORD had commanded him; so he did.
verses.after: Moses did everything just as the LORD had commanded him; that is what he did.
verses.tsw_comparator: Moses did according to all that the LORD had commanded him; so he did.

verses.rationale: Retains exact three-part date and passive establishment without modern calendar conversion.
verses.before: In the first month of the second year, on the first day of the month, the dwelling was set up.
verses.after: The tabernacle was set up on the first day of the first month in the second year.
verses.tsw_comparator: In the first month of the second year, on the first day of the month, the dwelling was set up.

verses.rationale: Preserves named agent and four structural actions in order.
verses.before: Moses set up the dwelling, placed its bases, set up its frames, put in its crossbars, and set up its pillars.
verses.after: Moses set up the tabernacle. He put its bases in place, raised its frames, inserted its crossbars, and erected its pillars.
verses.tsw_comparator: Moses set up the dwelling, placed its bases, set up its frames, put in its crossbars, and set up its pillars.

verses.rationale: Retains layer distinction and recurring exact fulfillment refrain.
verses.before: He spread the tent over the dwelling and put the covering of the tent over it from above, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: He spread the tent over the tabernacle and put the tent’s covering over it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: He spread the tent over the dwelling and put the covering of the tent over it from above, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Keeps three actions and distinct testimony/poles/cover rather than conflating objects.
verses.before: He took the testimony and put it into the ark, put the poles on the ark, and put the cover on the ark from above.
verses.after: He took the testimony and placed it inside the ark, fitted the poles to the ark, and put the atonement cover on top.
verses.tsw_comparator: He took the testimony and put it into the ark, put the poles on the ark, and put the cover on the ark from above.

verses.rationale: Preserves repeated screening function and exact obedience refrain.
verses.before: He brought the ark into the dwelling, set up the screening veil, and screened the ark of the testimony, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: He brought the ark into the tabernacle and hung the screening curtain, screening off the ark of the testimony, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: He brought the ark into the dwelling, set up the screening veil, and screened the ark of the testimony, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Keeps north position and outside-inner-curtain relation, not outside tent.
verses.before: He put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the dwelling, outside the veil,
verses.after: He placed the table in the tent of meeting on the north side of the tabernacle, outside the dividing curtain.
verses.tsw_comparator: He put the table in the tent of meeting, on the north side of the dwelling, outside the veil,

verses.rationale: Retains bread arrangement before God and exact refrain.
verses.before: and arranged the bread upon it before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: He arranged the bread on it before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: and arranged the bread upon it before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Keeps opposite/north-south spatial relationship without switching sides.
verses.before: He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table, on the south side of the dwelling,
verses.after: He placed the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: He put the lampstand in the tent of meeting opposite the table, on the south side of the dwelling,

verses.rationale: Preserves action, before-God location and refrain.
verses.before: and set up the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: He lit the lamps before the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: and set up the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Retains gold designation and outside-inner-curtain position clarifying verse 5.
verses.before: He put the gold altar in the tent of meeting before the veil
verses.after: He placed the gold altar in the tent of meeting in front of the dividing curtain.
verses.tsw_comparator: He put the gold altar in the tent of meeting before the veil

verses.rationale: Keeps aromatic offering and exact fulfillment refrain.
verses.before: and burned fragrant incense upon it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: He burned fragrant incense on it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: and burned fragrant incense upon it, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Preserves discrete outer entrance installation without importing court screen.
verses.before: He set up the screen at the entrance of the dwelling.
verses.after: He hung the entrance screen for the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: He set up the screen at the entrance of the dwelling.

verses.rationale: Retains altar location, two offering types and Moses’ agency with refrain.
verses.before: He put the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the dwelling, the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: He placed the altar of burnt offering at the entrance to the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, and offered the burnt offering and grain offering on it, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: He put the altar of burnt offering at the entrance of the dwelling, the tent of meeting, and offered upon it the burnt offering and the grain offering, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Keeps between spatial relation and water’s explicit washing purpose.
verses.before: He put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,
verses.after: He placed the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar, and put water in it for washing.
verses.tsw_comparator: He put the basin between the tent of meeting and the altar and put water in it for washing,

verses.rationale: Retains Moses included among washing users, sons’ father clarified, and both bodily parts.
verses.before: and Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet from it.
verses.after: Moses, Aaron, and Aaron’s sons would wash their hands and feet with water from it.
verses.tsw_comparator: and Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and feet from it.

verses.rationale: Keeps habitual washing in both service settings and refrain.
verses.before: When they entered the tent of meeting and when they approached the altar, they washed, as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.after: Whenever they entered the tent of meeting or approached the altar, they would wash, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.tsw_comparator: When they entered the tent of meeting and when they approached the altar, they washed, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

verses.rationale: Preserves surrounding both structures, final screen and explicit work completion.
verses.before: He set up the court around the dwelling and the altar and hung the screen at the gate of the court. So Moses completed the work.
verses.after: He set up the courtyard around the tabernacle and the altar, and hung the screen at the courtyard entrance. So Moses finished the work.
verses.tsw_comparator: He set up the court around the dwelling and the altar and hung the screen at the gate of the court. So Moses completed the work.

verses.rationale: Keeps distinct cloud-covering/glory-filling actions as narrative climax, not vague divine approval.
verses.before: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the dwelling.
verses.after: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: Then the cloud covered the tent of meeting, and the glory of the LORD filled the dwelling.

verses.rationale: Preserves Moses’ inability to enter, indwelling-cloud reason and repeated glory-filling claim.
verses.before: Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled upon it and the glory of the LORD filled the dwelling.
verses.after: Moses could not enter the tent of meeting because the cloud had settled on it and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.
verses.tsw_comparator: Moses was not able to enter the tent of meeting because the cloud settled upon it and the glory of the LORD filled the dwelling.

verses.rationale: Keeps recurring conditional movement and cloud lifting as departure signal.
verses.before: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the dwelling, the children of Israel would set out in all their journeys.
verses.after: Whenever the cloud lifted from the tabernacle, the Israelites would set out on their journeys.
verses.tsw_comparator: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the dwelling, the children of Israel would set out in all their journeys.

verses.rationale: Retains complementary negative condition and waiting duration, not generalized guidance summary.
verses.before: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out until the day it was taken up.
verses.after: But if the cloud did not lift, they would not set out until the day it lifted.
verses.tsw_comparator: But if the cloud was not taken up, then they did not set out until the day it was taken up.

verses.rationale: Keeps day/night cloud/fire, unresolved in-it referent, whole-house visibility and all-journeys refrain.
verses.before: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the dwelling by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys.
verses.after: For the LORD’s cloud was over the tabernacle by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of the whole house of Israel throughout all their journeys.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the cloud of the LORD was upon the dwelling by day, and fire was in it by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel throughout all their journeys.
